uncertainty.unit: PAWS pair with directions and models kept jointly, sampling 10 pairs with replacement within each original binary-label stratum. HANS item with models kept jointly, independently sampling five items with replacement within each analysis_role x original-label stratum; no selection/confirmation pooling.
uncertainty.limits: Tiny balanced curated samples. Conditional item-resampling intervals can be degenerate and do not establish equivalence or population effects. They omit model reruns, alternative batch contexts, source article/topic clustering and selection uncertainty. A larger fresh holdout is needed for generalization. No formal significance claim.
uncertainty.interval_method: Two-sided equal-tailed percentile: quantiles 0.025 and 0.975, linear interpolation (NumPy quantile method=linear).
uncertainty.selection_treatment: Hold observed unique proxy and target winners fixed for confirmation consequence/regret in every bootstrap draw; do not reselect. If either stage ties, primary consequence remains indeterminate.
